cases.name: holdout3-personal-voice-semicolon-memo
cases.promptMarkdown:
Use the `siang:personal-voice` skill (Skill tool, `skill: "siang:personal-voice"`). The three files in `samples/` are notes Marta, our finance lead, wrote to the team. `draft.md` is an update someone drafted for her to send, and it does not sound like her at all. Rewrite `draft.md` in place so it reads as if Marta wrote it. Keep every fact in it: names, amounts, ticket ids and dates. Do not edit anything in `samples/`.

Your final message is one line saying what you changed, nothing else.

If the Skill tool reports the skill as unknown or unavailable, do the same task yourself and still end with the final message described above.

config.pattern: hope this (?:email|message|note) finds you|hesitate to (?:reach out|contact)|thrilled|game.changer|keep the momentum|exciting update

cases.name: holdout3-personal-voice-thai-chat
cases.promptMarkdown:
Use the `siang:personal-voice` skill (Skill tool, `skill: "siang:personal-voice"`). The three files in `samples/` are Slack posts Nok, our on-call engineer, wrote in the team channel. `draft.md` is an incident update someone drafted for Nok to post, and it sounds nothing like Nok. Rewrite `draft.md` in place so it reads as if Nok wrote it, in Thai as Nok does. Keep every fact in it: names, numbers, ticket ids and dates. Do not edit anything in `samples/`.

Your final message is one line saying what you changed, nothing else.

If the Skill tool reports the skill as unknown or unavailable, do the same task yourself and still end with the final message described above.
